stories.summary: Combined net interest income at the country's listed commercial banks turned negative in the first nine months of 2026, for the first time in at least six years, as weak loan demand and bad loans weighed on earnings. The 27 listed lenders reported negative net interest income of Tk 5,624 crore, against a positive Tk 3,016 crore a year earlier. Income from government bonds carried much of the load, rising 21 percent to Tk 32,622 crore, while seven banks lost more than Tk 13,000 crore between them.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative lending income shows how bad loans are hollowing out banks' core business — a central banking-exam indicator.

stories.summary: Democrats vowed to use their midterm victory to rein in President Donald Trump, setting up two years of possible deadlock in Washington, as Trump showed off his under-construction White House ballroom.
